title: fix(plugin-grid): the import wizard's Save current template button says why it is disabled
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPbtsWqtivtbY6k5wqzzBt5)_

Fixes #31493

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 导入向导映射步骤里,模板栏的「Save current」在一列都没映射时仍是禁用的,但现在包在一个可聚焦的外层里:悬停或 Tab 聚焦会弹出提示「Map at least one column to save a template.」,读屏也会读到这句原因。映射了至少一列后,它和以前一样是普通可点按钮。
- **为什么改:** QA #31486 发现该按钮禁用时不给任何原因,键盘 Tab 直接跳过,读屏也无说明,违反 `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason`。同一步骤的 Next 按钮早已用同样模式通过。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 `TemplateBar` 的「Save current」一处,禁用条件不变(仍是「没有任何映射列」);新增一个 i18n 键,十一个语言包都有。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`(`TemplateBar` 的 `nothingMapped` 分支)、`importMissingRequiredHint.describedBy-12303.test.tsx`(新 describe)、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts`(新键译文)。
- **两分钟验证:** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/importMissingRequiredHint.describedBy-12303.test.tsx`,预期 7 个用例全绿,其中 4 个是本卡新增。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`:** `TemplateBar`'s `disabled` prop is renamed `nothingMapped`, the one condition its only caller passes (`Object.keys(mapping).length === 0`), so the reason it draws cannot drift from the condition. While it holds, the natively disabled "Save current" button sits inside a focusable `span` (`tabIndex={0}`, `data-disabled-reason`) that is the trigger of a `Tooltip` from `@object-ui/components`, the same wrapper the step's Next button and `DisabledReasonTrigger` use. The button and the span are both `aria-describedby` an `sr-only` copy of the reason, so a screen reader hears it with the tooltip closed. Once a column is mapped the button renders alone, with no wrapper and no description, as before. The inline confirm-save button reads the renamed prop; its behaviour is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`:** one new key, `grid.import.saveCurrentNeedsMapping` ("Map at least one column to save a template."), in all eleven `locales/*.ts` packs; zh-Hant generated from zh-Hans with `gen:zh-hant`. The wizard's own English fallback map `IMPORT_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` gains the same key, which `ImportWizard.i18n-parity.test.ts` holds equal to `en.grid.import`.

## Tests

A new top-level describe in the existing Next-button reason harness `importMissingRequiredHint.describedBy-12303.test.tsx` (the real wizard, pasted rows):

- With no column mapped (headers `foo`, `bar`): the button is disabled and described by the reason; its parent is the `data-disabled-reason` span, a tab stop, described by the same element.
- Keyboard: Tab from the template select lands on the wrapper, and the tooltip opens with the reason.
- Hover on the wrapper opens the tooltip with the reason.
- CONTROL: with `Name` mapped, the button is enabled, carries no `aria-describedby`, has no wrapper, and the reason text is not in the document.

The three existing Next-button cases in the same file stay green.

## Acceptance notes

- None.
